item.description: The wet and windy weather failed to dampen spirits at the Market Harborough Christmas Fayre. item.title: Community Supports Family Of Much-Loved Father & Husband
item.description: Over £4,000 has been donated to support the family of a much-loved father and husband from Desborough. item.title: Man Released Under Investigation After Collision In Desborough
item.description: A man arrested after a teenage boy was seriously injured in a crash in Desborough has been released under investigation. item.title: Multiple Cars Damaged By Pothole
item.description: A number of drivers suffered burst tyres after hitting a large pothole on a road near Desborough yesterday evening. Police were called to scene on Oakley Road in Pipewell just before 5pm, after up to nine vehicles had been damaged. Drivers reported blow-outs and buckled wheels.
